newsitem.title: UK: UK FTSE ends at record close on rate outlook, Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK FTSE ends at record close on rate outlook, Dow.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index ended at a record closing high for the fifth session in a row on Monday as continued strength on Wall Street and a more relaxed peception of the British inflation outlook boosted shares.
Dealers said the domestic economic picture for the FTSE remained bullish and the market could scale even loftier peaks as long as Wall Street maintained its firm tone.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares hit a record of 4,440.8 in morning trade and ended at 4,437.4, 17.1 points firmer. The FTSE 250 index of mid-capitalisation stocks matched the record-breaking exploits of the leading share market, ending at a new peak of 4,729.2.
